I stayed in the rehab for about 02 months. The first few days were tough, but then I got used to the routine. They have multiple sessions and activities during the day that keep the you occupied and provide a structure to the day. The counsellors (Mr. Ashish, Guruji and others) are all very knowledgeable and empathetic. They provide a great support system and help you tackle your problems from the root up.

Its been 02 years since I have left the rehab and being sober has never been easier. The thought of using drugs or alcohol does'nt even cross my mind. Its like I was never an addict. I am truely thankful to my family and the team at Trucare for helping me get my life back on track.

If you are someone who is struggling with addiction, this is truely the right place to be in. Don't delay it, Don't think about it, Don't try to do it on your own. Get admitted now!!

Hope this review helps.
God Bless.

🧠 PTSD: Trauma Doesn’t Have to Define Your Future

A frightening accident, physical assault, abuse, war, natural disaster, or the sudden loss of a loved one can leave emotional scars that continue long after the event is over.

Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD) is a genuine medical condition—not a sign of weakness. It affects how the brain processes fear, memory, and emotions, and it can interfere with work, relationships, sleep, and daily life.

⚠️ Common Symptoms
• Recurrent flashbacks or nightmares
• Avoiding reminders of the trauma
• Feeling emotionally numb or detached
• Irritability or anger outbursts
• Hypervigilance (always “on guard”)
• Poor sleep and concentration
• Feelings of guilt, shame, or hopelessness

💚 The Good News? PTSD is Treatable.

Evidence-based treatments such as:
✅ Trauma-focused Cognitive Behaviour Therapy (CBT)
✅ EMDR (Eye Movement Desensitization & Reprocessing)
✅ Appropriate medications (when needed)
✅ Stress management and lifestyle changes
can significantly improve recovery and quality of life.
🌱 Early treatment often leads to better outcomes.

🧠 Do You Find Yourself Repeatedly Pulling Your Hair? It Could Be Trichotillomania.

Hair pulling is not simply a "bad habit." For many people, it is a treatable mental health condition called Trichotillomania (Hair Pulling Disorder).

People with trichotillomania often experience:
✔ Repeated pulling of scalp hair, eyebrows, eyelashes, or beard hair
✔ Difficulty controlling the urge despite wanting to stop
✔ Temporary relief after pulling
✔ Visible hair thinning or bald patches
✔ Feelings of embarrassment, guilt, or low confidence

This condition can affect children, teenagers, and adults. Stress, anxiety, boredom, perfectionism, or emotional distress may worsen symptoms.

The good news is that effective treatments are available. Evidence-based approaches such as Habit Reversal Training (HRT), Cognitive Behaviour Therapy (CBT), and appropriate medications when needed can significantly reduce hair-pulling urges and improve quality of life.

Early treatment can prevent progression and help restore confidence.

I visited Rajneesh Kant on April 17, and honestly, the experience was quite disappointing.

There were no clear instructions on what to expect beforehand, apart from generic YouTube videos that set very high expectations. At the clinic, I had to wait for hours before being seen.

When my turn finally came, the actual consultation lasted less than five minutes. There was no proper assessment or detailed discussion of my issue. He asked a few brief questions and moved straight to a quick adjustment.

What stood out more was the lack of professionalism. At times, while I was explaining my problem, the doctor seemed to be laughing and exchanging looks with his assistants, which felt inappropriate.

The treatment itself was done in an open area, in front of many other patients, with no sense of privacy. That was quite uncomfortable.

Also, having experienced chiropractic care in the US, this felt very rushed and far from thorough. The adjustment was limited to neck and shoulder, yet I was charged ₹30,000 for what was described as a “full body adjustment.”

I was simply told to come back after two months if needed. Given the overall experience, I don’t plan to return.

Worst Experience

This was a very disappointing and frustrating experience. I am not certain, but the doctor came across to us as dishonest and misleading.

My father has significant hearing loss and uses hearing aids (approximately 70% loss in one ear and 80% in the other). The doctor and his assistant repeatedly claimed that this level of hearing loss was “not an issue” and that they have successfully cured similar cases in the past. We strongly disagree with these claims.

We were first asked to pay ₹1,000 as a confirmation amount and ₹10,000 for a single session. My father spent nearly 6 hours at the clinic, yet the actual consultation/treatment by Dr. Rajneesh lasted barely 5–10 minutes. There was no improvement in my father’s hearing after the session, which made us feel that the so-called “hearing cure” being marketed is nothing more than a gimmick.

The overall experience at the clinic was exhausting and poorly managed. There were no proper waiting arrangements, making it extremely uncomfortable—especially for elderly patients. On top of that, the clinic openly promotes a VIP culture, where public figures and influential people are given priority over others who have been waiting in the queue for hours.

Overall, this was a waste of time, money, and energy. I would strongly advise others to be cautious and seek proper medical opinions before trusting such claims.

She will always remain special. These guys know what they’re doing!

What makes them exceptional is their intent. They don’t want you dependent on them. They genuinely want you to heal, grow stronger, and reach the best potential of your body so you can live well without needing to keep coming back. That mindset is rare.

If you’re honest, consistent, and willing to do the work, they make your recovery their personal mission. I’m deeply grateful to Dr. Amit Koli and Dr. Rozina—for fixing my back, restoring my confidence, and giving me hope when I had very little left. You guys are doing god’s work.
